children: The Philly Fed Manufacturing Index fell to
in September from 47.4 in August, beating the 31.3 consensus, according to data released by the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia on Thursday.
Some 45% of firms reported either increases or no change in current activity, while 8% reported decreases.

The index for future general activity retreated 21 points to 52.9 this month, its lowest reading since July, the Philly Fed said. Almost 58% of the firms expect a rise in activity over the next six months, 5% expect a decrease, and 33% expect no change.
